results.title: Women in Love
results.overview: A gaggle of young women gather at the seaside to celebrate their friend's birthday and help mend her recently broken heart. As the women confide in each other and trade thoughts on love, a young American man catches their attention, and they begin to engage in a series of games.

results.title: Women & Men 2: In Love There Are No Rules
results.original_title: Women & Men 2: In Love There Are No Rules
results.overview: Three short stories about women & men relationship.

results.title: Women Who Love Women: Conversations in Singapore
results.original_title: Women Who Love Women: Conversations in Singapore
results.overview: Singapore's first lesbian documentary used interview footage with 3 Singaporean lesbians  - Amanda Lee, Sabrina Renee Chong and Gea Swee Jean - to get a rare glimpse into lesbian lives in Singapore. Intimate and surprisingly candid, these lesbians talk about their lives, loves and views on topics such as coming out and relationships. Sometimes heartbreaking, and oftentimes funny, the documentary captures the lives of lesbians who have chosen to live authentically and is a testament to the courage, tenacity and individualism of lesbians living in Singapore.

results.title: Dear Diary: The Story of Two Women In Love
results.original_title: Dear Diary: The Story of Two Women In Love
results.overview: Recovering from a breakup, rock-singer Kate (Jo-Ann Barton) falls in love with her computer teacher Bonnie (Mary De Michele). Kate goes through a maze of emotional highs and lows, and throughout it all, Kate's manager, Marty (Deana Demko), drives everyone crazy protecting her. To add to the turmoil, Marty constantly battles with Kate's roomate David (Lou Pennacchio).  Follow Kat and Bonnie's most intimate thoughts through the pages of the diaries. Strong musical performances wrapped in a compelling drama where a misunderstanding results in tragedy.

results.title: Women in Love: Bonding Strategies of Black Lesbians
results.original_title: Women in Love: Bonding Strategies of Black Lesbians
results.overview: Women in love features black women talking about their public and private lives. Their discussion of families, lovers, and the way they move through society is as entertaining as it is informative.

results.title: Women in Love: Trembling Triple Ecstasy
results.original_title: 恋する女たち　トリプルエクスタシー　けいれん
results.overview: Yoko, Shoko, and Kyoko are three female college students. Yoko has a boyfriend named Hiroshi, but when she hears that Shoko is having an affair, she becomes anxious. She also dreams of having an affair. Yoko approaches her professor Maehara to have an affair. Kyoko ends up sleeping with Yoko's boyfriend Hiroshi by chance. And then the three of them.

results.title: Married Woman Boutique: Women Indulging in Scandalous Love Affair
results.original_title: 人妻ブティック 不倫生下着
results.overview: Kimie steps into a boutique each day to support her household in place of her husband, who is unable to work due to heart disease—while her own spirit aches with longing. She surrenders willingly to the irresistible pull of Tsukuda, the dashing apparel‐maker’s salesman whose whispered promises slip between her legs like silk. Kenji, burning to reclaim his former glory, watches his world unravel when he discovers the affair that simmered beneath Kimie’s restraint. And as the truth of Kimie’s glowing secret—her  pregnancy—dawns on him, his reproaches choke in his throat, meeting instead a startling, fervent embrace from the woman he thought he knew…

results.title: Women, Love, and Mystery: The Darkness in the Palm of My Hand
results.original_title: 女と愛とミステリ: てのひらの闇
results.overview: A salaryman must find out why his boss committed suicide after discovering a video for a new marketing campaign is fake. This was a feature-length film released in the two hour  "Women, Love, and Mystery " program on TV Tokyo.

results.name: Why Women Love
results.overview: Zhao Jiangyue, the no-nonsense head of a tech firm, is a master at business but clueless in matters of the heart. When Gu Jiaxin, heir to a business group and a successful racing driver, is assigned as her temporary assistant, they clash.

results.name: Women of the Sun
results.overview: Shin Do Young is an announcer who instigates the jealously of all women around her because of her superior looks, great abilities, and great background. But Do Young has a deep, dark secret. She was actually abandoned at an orphanage when she was young but luckily she was adopted by a nice couple.

results.name: Ai no Wakakusa Yama Monogatari
results.overview: The comic story of Shizuka, the eldest daughter, who lives at home, showing no signs of getting married; her mother, who is both annoyed with Shizuka, and at the same time concerned about her window of eligibility; her sister Ikumi, with whom she gets along, even though they fight; and her father, who feels henpecked in this all-female household.

results.title: Love, In Between
results.overview: After discovering her husband Jiseok's affair, Soyoung befriends his mistress, hiding her true intentions as she quietly enters the woman's life.

results.title: Women in Cell Block 7
results.original_title: Diario segreto da un carcere femminile
results.overview: A woman goes behind bars in order to save her father's life.

results.title: For Love or Money
results.overview: Using almost totally historical material, For Love or Money encompasses the role of Australian women in both paid and unpaid work, over a 200 year period.

results.title: The Three Lewd Sisters
results.overview: Tsukimi had just married Masao. One night, while they were having sex, Tsukimi received a call from her younger sister, Hanami, a high school student. Hanami told her that their eldest sister, Yukimi, had been divorced after her affair was discovered and she had returned home. Yukimi had had affairs many times before, and each time she had been divorced. According to her, she could only enjoy having affairs because she was married. She also said that the apartment manager she was currently having an affair with was the best sex she had ever had

results.name: Mujeres Apasionadas
results.overview: La serie gira en torno a la dañada relación entre un saxofonista y una mujer que se enamora de un exnovio, al que había dejado para casarse con él.

results.title: Bittersweet Rainbow
results.overview: Nicolò, 24, returns home after 7 years. Through a path made of affections and memories his love story with Claudio and the reason for his escape will come back to him.

results.title: Soy Nevenka
results.overview: Película sobre el caso de Nevenka Fernández, la concejala del Ayuntamiento de Ponferrada que en 2001 se atrevió a denunciar por acoso sexual a Ismael Álvarez, el alcalde de la localidad por aquel entonces. Fue la primera en lograr una condena a un cargo político por este motivo.

known_for.overview: Un director ciego se ve envuelto en un escándalo relacionado con una película cuando su ex productor muere. Tras la muerte, el hijo del productor le pide al director que le ayude a escribir un guión en contra del difunto. Mientras tanto los recuerdos del cineasta revelan un romance con una secretaria.

known_for.title: El Crimen Ferpecto
known_for.overview: Un mujeriego vano (Guillermo Toledo) es chantajeado por su compañera de trabajo fea y libertina cuando le ayuda a deshacerse del cadáver de su jefe. Mónica Cervera.

known_for.title: La desconocida
known_for.overview: Tras hallar a una mujer con amnesia en un contenedor de carga, dos detectives trabajan a toda marcha para averiguar su identidad... y quién la quiere muerta.

results.name: Cris Miró (Ella)
results.overview: Serie que sigue el recorrido por la vida y la trayectoria de Cris Miró, la primera vedette trans argentina de éxito, ícono de los años 90, que fue una revolucionaria de la época y cuyo legado sigue vigente hoy en día.

known_for.title: El faro de las orcas
known_for.overview: Una madre viaja a Patagonia con su hijo autista con la esperanza que un guardabosques y una vaina de orcas salvajes le pueden ayudar a encontrar una conexión emocional.

known_for.title: Que Dios nos perdone
known_for.overview: Javier Alfaro, un policía de homicidios con problemas de conducta acaba de incorporarse a su trabajo tras un periodo de suspensión por agresión. José Velarde es su compañero y además su antítesis… callado, retraído, tartamudo y absolutamente minucioso en sus investigaciones. Ambos deben enfrentarse a un asesino en serie de ancianas que actúa en el centro de Madrid y cuyas pautas son ganarse la confianza de las ancianas hasta conseguir entrar en sus casas donde las viola y las mata a golpes.

known_for.title: ma ma
known_for.overview: Después de una tragedia una mujer, Magda, reacciona con una oleada de la vida recién descubierta que sumerge su círculo de familia y amigos.

known_for.title: ¡Qué viva el merengue y la lambada!
known_for.original_title: ¡Qué viva el merengue y la lambada!

known_for.name: Alba
known_for.overview: Alba se despierta en una playa con señales de haber sido violada, pero sin recordar.

known_for.name: Si lo hubiera sabido
known_for.overview: Emma lleva diez años en un matrimonio decepcionante y no puede más. Entonces se le presenta la extraordinaria oportunidad de volver a vivir la última década.

known_for.title: El clan
known_for.overview: La historia se basa en el caso policial del Clan Puccio, que conmocionó a la sociedad argentina a principios de los 80. Tras la aparente normalidad de la familia Puccio se oculta un siniestro clan dedicado al secuestro y al asesinato. Arquímedes, el patriarca, miembro del Servicio de Inteligencia desde la dictadura, lidera y planifica las operaciones. Alejandro, el hijo mayor, estrella de un club de rugby, se sirve de su popularidad para no levantar sospechas. Los demás miembros de la familia son cómplices en mayor o menor grado de los crímenes del clan, y viven de los beneficios obtenidos de los rescates que pagan los familiares de los secuestrados.

known_for.name: Soy Luna
known_for.overview: Luna es una joven adolescente que descubrirá que el amor perdura a pesar del tiempo y la distancia. Ella fue abandonada de bebé por razones que no son lo que parecen al principio. Junto con sus padres llegan de México a Buenos Aires para emprender una nueva etapa de sus vidas. Durante esta travesía, conocerá a personas de contextos diversos que podrían acercarla a sus orígenes. Mientras tanto, la pasión, la amistad y el amor la ayudarán a sentirse apegada al camino que decide seguir en busca de su felicidad.

known_for.title: Malasaña 32
known_for.overview: Barrio de Malasaña, Madrid, España, 1976. Mientras la agitación política asola las calles de todo el país, la familia Olmedo llega a la gran ciudad y se instala en su nuevo piso. Pronto descubrirán que no son los únicos que recorren sus pasillos.

known_for.original_title: A mi madre le gustan las mujeres

known_for.title: Torrente presidente
known_for.overview: José Luis Torrente, siempre convencido de ser un héroe nacional de España pese a su ineptitud, es persuadido para meterse en política y, con su estilo vulgar, demagógico y lleno de ocurrencias, logra convertirse en líder de un partido populista.

known_for.name: MasterChef Celebrity
known_for.overview: Diez famosos aspirantes deben mostrar su pericia culinaria, oculta hasta hoy y que solo sus familiares y amigos han disfrutado, mientras que otros empiezan casi desde cero y deben ponerse a su altura.

results.title: The Ledge
results.overview: A thriller in which a battle of philosophies between a fundamentalist Christian and an atheist who shares an apartment with a gay friend escalates into a lethal battle of wills.

results.title: The Ledge
results.overview: A rock climbing adventure between two friends turns into a terrifying nightmare. After Kelly captures the murder of her best friend on camera, she becomes the next target of a tight knit group of friends who will stop at nothing to destroy the evidence and anyone in their way.

results.title: Over the Ledge
results.overview: A poor widow dies, leaving her two young children, Bob and Mabel, in the care of a poor neighbor, who later is forced by circumstances to give them to an asylum. Twenty years pass and Jack, who has been adopted by a good family, has now gone into business for himself and is a rising young broker. He has been searching the detective agencies for his sister, without success, for some years. Mabel ran away from the asylum and has been brought up by a poor family, is without education and is now employed as a servant, and on a certain day is hanging clothes on a roof nearby a large office building, in which Bob has his office, and a small boy is flying his kite from the same rooftop.

results.title: Man on the Ledge
results.overview: Beat cop Bragan is about to go off duty when he discovers a man standing on the ledge of a hotel more than a dozen stories up. Bragan tries to talk the man, Robert Cosick, down from his threatening perch and in the process learns the reasons for the Robert's suicide attempt.

results.title: Off the Ledge
results.overview: Sex, drugs and suicidal tendencies... HAPPY NEW YEAR! This ensemble driven dramedy revolves around an eccentric New Years Eve Party, where the Party-Goers are oblivious to the true atmosphere of pain amid the celebration of "life".

results.title: The Ledge End of Phil
results.overview: Stuck outside looking in, Phil is forced to face the world he's been ignoring. Now he must take a leap of faith or be trapped forever!

results.title: Woman on the Ledge
results.overview: Three longtime friends each struggle with a major life crisis threatening to destroy her.

results.title: Know The Ledge
results.overview: This short follows a black couple as they spend their first day together on the streets of South Central Los Angeles.

results.title: Life on the Ledge
results.overview: Brian Leib, a thirty-two year old, ritualistic neurotic recluse who lives with his paranoid parents, only leaves his house to see his psychiatrist. His days are kept as simple as the loaf of bread he makes every morning; the first slice his breakfast, the last slice his dessert--this gives him a "sense of closure for the day." On the verge of jumping he finds a tumor on his neck. Through this new found bad news he gets the strength to talk to Claire, another patient of his psychiatrist's. Claire, a beautiful stripper with a badly stained childhood lets her male guard down and lets Brian in. In order to protect Claire, Brian gets involved with a motley crew of gangsters, faces his fears and gains the will to live... but is it too late?

results.title: Fairport Convention: Beyond the Ledge
results.overview: The British Invasion continues! Fairport Convention, the British counterpart to Jefferson Airplane, began their musical journey in 1967, and it continues today. Each year, the band hosts a folk music festival in Cropredy, England, where new and original band members come together to commemorate the folk spirit of yore and the folk tunes of today. See the band perform favorites such as "Who Knows Where the Time Goes" and "Meet on the Ledge."

results.title: Jonathan Winters: On the Ledge
results.overview: From an uproarious news spoof to a luncheonette that specializes in some sandwiches, Jonathan Winters and his wild bunch wreak comedy havoc in this wacky walk on the wild side.

results.title: The Ledge 4D Experience
results.overview: Located within the Cliffs of Moher Experience Visitor Centre, the Ledge 4D Experience takes visitors on an interactive 3-minute tour of the cliffs and combines stunning visuals of the world-famous cliffs on a calm summer’s day, both above the sea and underwater, with the environmental effects of west of Ireland wind and spray of Moher mist.

results.title: Reading From the Ledge Site
results.overview: "The semi-handmade reading from the ledge site (2016) borrows its shades of red and seafoam green from the early moments of Dust. Rather than growing in size, its shafts of light seem to grow more intense as they reveal uncharacteristic footage." --Bennett Glace

known_for.title: It's All Because of a Katoey
known_for.original_title: กะเทยเป็นเหตุ
known_for.overview: A beautiful woman picks up her fiancé at a gentleman's club where the members play pool. She is so attractive that other men begin to compete for her attention. One, a lieutenant who she won't give the time of day, finds out a little more about her than he bargained for.

results.title: The Last Ledger
results.overview: Based on the memoir Special Housing Unit, The Last Ledger follows Raj Chowdhury, a brilliant fin-tech entrepreneur whose meteoric rise through technology and finance collapses under the weight of federal prosecution. Inside prison, stripped of power and identity, he confronts betrayal, survival, and the systems built to break men. From solitary confinement to rebuilding a global financial empire, the story traces a journey through ambition, ruin, and resurrection.

results.name: Bridgerton spin-off based on the story of young Violet Ledger and Viscount Edmund Bridgerton
results.original_name: Bridgerton spin-off based on the story of young Violet Ledger and Viscount Edmund Bridgerton

results.title: The Dream Ledger
results.overview: A group of five complete strangers who are haunted by their own dreams and trauma from their past connect on the Internet -- and they decide to travel to the one motel where they all experienced the cause of their own separate nightmares.

results.title: The Ledger
results.overview: After working at a factory for years, Cevdet finds himself facing a profound sense of emptiness upon retirement. In an attempt to cope with the uncertainty in his life, he clings tightly to his old factory routine and obsessively continues to record every detail around him in the "Ledger" he brought home from work. However, taking in his late neighbor’s dog introduces a new kind of chaos into his life—one that cannot be confined to the lines of a notebook or controlled. Although Cevdet tries to control the dog, its disobedient nature forces him to confront his own limitations.

results.name: The God of Revenge's Ledger
results.overview: A supremely powerful magnate conceals his true identity to become a live-in son-in-law, all for the sake of a deep-rooted revenge. He endures all kinds of humiliation and torment from his wife's family (the Phattharaphaisan Family), who are completely unaware of his real status. When his true identity is finally revealed, it sends shockwaves and chaos throughout the entire city. The great king has returned, and he is ready to exact his revenge a thousand times over!

results.title: The Other Side of the Ledger: An Indian View of the Hudson's Bay Company
results.original_title: The Other Side of the Ledger: An Indian View of the Hudson's Bay Company
results.overview: The Hudson's Bay Company's 300th anniversary celebration was no occasion for joy among the people whose lives were tied to the trading stores. This film, narrated by George Manuel, president of the National Indian Brotherhood, presents the view of spokesmen for Canadian Indian and Métis groups. There is a sharp contrast between the official celebrations, with Queen Elizabeth II among the guests, and what Indians have to say about their lot in the Company's operations.

results.title: La Cornisa
results.overview: Tras haber tenido un tórrido romance con la mujer de un vecino (Liv Tyler), Gavin (Charlie Hunnam) está en la cornisa de un edificio de gran altura con la intención de saltar al vacío antes de mediodía. Un policía (Terrence Howard) intentará por todos los medios manejar la situación e impedir el suicidio de Gavin

results.title: Al borde del abismo
results.overview: Nick Cassidy, un ex policía, amenaza con saltar desde la azotea de un hotel de Manhattan. Mientras el departamento de Policía de Nueva York envía a una psicóloga policial para tranquilizarlo, sin que la policía presente lo sepa, se descubre las intenciones detras del intento de suicidio.

results.title: Taxi a Gibraltar
results.overview: El héroe principal de la película por nombre de León Lafuente es al taxista español. Él siempre malo es completo de los deberes. Está harto, como rápidamente todo se cambia: su taxi, sus alrededores, su mundo y el vientre de su mujer embarazada. Todo se cambia para León. Diego Manfredi mismo hermoso, tanto como el engañador. Él acaba de salir de la cárcel. Nadie ha llegado a encontrarlo. Los años en la cárcel lo han dejado sin familia o el futuro y con una gran cantidad de los deberes. Sandra Sánchez vive es aburrido, como la ostra. Siendo salvado de la aldea, donde ha pasado la mitad de la vida en el ambiente de los olivos. Siendo salvado de los amigos, todos son casados, y del muchacho. Tres los infortunados salen al viaje delirante con la promesa de la entrega del oro perdido en los túneles del lugar más raro y desconocido sobre la península Ibérica: el Gibraltar.

results.title: A Golden Boy
results.overview: A young copywriter moves to Rome in the wake of his screenwriter father's death, where he meets a publisher who wants to release his dad's autobiography.

results.title: The Shadow of the Day
results.overview: In 1938 Italy, after Jews are banned from public life, fascist-abiding restaurateur Luciano nonetheless believes he can still live by his own rules. Everything changes when Anna, a girl with a dangerous secret, begins working at his business.

results.title: Zoe y Tempestad
results.overview: Nacida y criada entre caballos, Zoe lleva una vida feliz impulsada por el sueño de convertirse algún día en jinete, al igual que su padre. El caballo preferido de Zoe da a luz a un potro al que llaman Tempestad. Ella será la primera en ver en él al campeón que su familia ha estado esperando siempre. Sin embargo, un grave accidente amenazará con poner todo eso en peligro.

results.title: Boston Strangler
results.overview: Reporters Loretta McLaughlin and Jean Cole bravely pursue the story of the Boston Strangler at great personal risk, putting their own lives on the line in their quest to uncover the truth.

results.title: The Boston Strangler
results.overview: Boston is being terrorized by a series of seemingly random murders of women. Based on the true story, the film follows the investigators path through several leads before introducing the Strangler as a character. It is seen almost exclusively from the point of view of the investigators who have very few clues to build a case upon.

results.title: The Boston Strangler
results.overview: Boston, Mass. 1962. The dawn of the serial killer was at hand. Thirteen innocent women were brutally slaughtered by a faceless monster. Now, through the eyes of the killer himself, we are taken on a sadistic journey from the jail cell to the grave, reliving each terrifying event one murder at a time.

results.title: Boston Strangler The Untold Story
results.overview: Boston Strangler: The Untold Story is an intense true-crime thriller about Albert De Salvo, a wise cracking, small time criminal with an unrelenting sex drive, who ultimately falsely confesses to being the strangler that wreaked havoc in Boston during the early sixties. Guided by his manipulative cell mate, who knows more about the murders than he reveals, they devise a plan to gain all of the notoriety from the killings and the money from the reward. Meanwhile, Detective John Marsden, searches out the truth certain that they were not committed by one man. Fighting the bureaucracy of the day, Marsden lets his emotions get the best of him as he follows the trail of the murders.

results.title: Confessions of the Boston Strangler
results.overview: This two-hour documentary special for Investigation Discovery sends viewers back to a time when no woman in Boston felt safe. The city finally felt a sigh of relief when, in a recorded confession, Albert DeSalvo admitted to his savage rampage and the first known serial killer in America was put behind bars. But decades later, compelling DNA analysis revealed that DeSalvo may not in fact have committed the crimes.

results.title: The Hunt for the Boston Strangler
results.original_title: The Hunt for the Boston Strangler
results.overview: Police closed the case of the infamous Boston Strangler when handyman Albert De Salvo confessed to the grisly murder of 13 women. But recent forensic evidence reveals that in at least one of the murders - and possibly all of them - police may have had the wrong man. Some even theorize that the strangler may be walking free today. Now, the National Geographic Channel investigates in The Hunt for the Boston Strangler.

results.title: The Boston Strangler: Unheard Confession
results.overview: Oxygen uncovers shocking new details about one of the most chilling cases in American history with “The Boston Strangler: Unheard Confession.” For the first time ever, viewers will hear from the long-lost 16-hour audio tapes of alleged serial killer Albert DeSalvo’s confession, offering a raw and unfiltered account of the crimes.

results.title: Notorious Killers: The Boston Strangler
results.overview: In 1965, Albert DeSalvo confessed to being the Boston Strangler, who had killed 13 women in a year-long rampage that had terrorized the city. But there have always been doubts about the validity in DeSalvo's confession and conviction. WHO WAS THE REAL BOSTON STRANGLER? Chronicles the controversy surrounding the case, from the fact that the tapes of DeSalvo's police interrogation have never been released to the strange circumstances surrounding the book. "The Boston Strangler', in which the author definitively declares DeSalvo to be the killer, despite having only second-hand information obtained through P. Lee Bailey, DeSalvo's attorney.

results.title: STRANGLEHOLD: In the Shadow of the Boston Strangler
results.original_title: STRANGLEHOLD: In the Shadow of the Boston Strangler
results.overview: In the 1960's, filmmaker Myles Jewell's grandfather, Phil DiNatale, worked relentlessly as an investigator on the case of the Boston Strangler. But despite Phil's meticulous investigative efforts, the case got caught in Boston's political cross hairs and was never officially solved. Now, fifty years later, Myles plunges headfirst into his grandfather's immense homemade detective archive to reveal never-before-seen details about the strangler investigation. Part historical film, part personal documentary, and part whodunit, Stranglehold tells the story of a beat cop turned famed detective, Phil DiNatale, and the long-lasting effect his investigative legacy had on his family for generations.

results.title: The Boston Strangler: The Hunt For a Killer
results.original_title: The Boston Strangler: The Hunt For a Killer
results.overview: The Boston Strangler terrorized the city of Boston in the 1960s, and history says Albert DeSalvo was the gruesome killer; today, modern advances in forensic science and public opinion tell a different, more tantalizing story.

results.title: Real Killer, Fake Nose: Richard Fleischer's 'The Boston Strangler' Remembered
results.original_title: Real Killer, Fake Nose: Richard Fleischer's 'The Boston Strangler' Remembered
results.overview: Documentary about the making of the movie "The Boston Strangler".

results.title: The Strangler
results.overview: An overweight lab technician with low self esteem, brought on by his dominant mother, becomes a serial killer of female nurses.

known_for.title: Death Scenes 2
known_for.overview: DEATH SCENES II continues the exploration into the dark recesses of violence and rage that ended in such heinous crimes as the Manson Family's assault on society. You'll see the gruesome aftermath of mob reprisals, public executions and international terrorism. DEATH SCENES II uniquely ushers the brave and curious into a spellbinding trip through the reality that is our world today.

known_for.name: Twisted
known_for.overview: TWISTED takes an in-depth look at the world's most prolific serial killers through first-hand accounts and testaments of those closest to them, and attempts to answer the question: Was it nature or nurture?

known_for.title: UFC 7: The Brawl In Buffalo
known_for.overview: UFC 7: The Brawl in Buffalo was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on September 8, 1995, at the Memorial Auditorium in Buffalo, New York. The event was seen live on pay per view in the United States, and later released on home video.

results.title: El estrangulador de Boston
results.overview: Una historia real de crimen y suspenso sobre las reporteras pioneras que resolvieron el caso de los impactantes asesinatos de Boston: Loretta McLaughlin, del periódico Record American, y su colega y confidente, Jean Cole. Mientras el asesino continúa cobrándose víctimas, estas mujeres valientes avanzan en la investigación, a pesar de arriesgar su vida, para descubrir la verdad.

results.title: Trial by Fire
results.overview: A firefighter is wrongly blamed for the death of her father, hours before he was due to retire from the department. Eager to prove herself to her peers, she sets out to join an elite squad of smoke jumpers who are expected to jump from aeroplanes into the heart of a blaze.

results.title: Trial by Fire
results.overview: A high-school teacher tries to help one of her troubled male students, who misinterprets her interest.

results.title: Trial by Fire
results.overview: One man struggles to regain his life after losing everything.

results.original_title: Walker, Texas Ranger: Trial by Fire
results.overview: Walker investigates a murder connected with a missing government weapon. In addition, he tries to track down a teen on the run from a crime syndicate.

results.title: Trial by Fire
results.overview: Terry Dunnage was set alight by his uncle in Paignton, Devon 2007. His uncle subsequently died in the fire, Terry survived by jumping out of a window. However things changed forever and Terry spent the next 3 months of his life in a coma fighting for his life. Further battles of immense proportions were to follow....

results.title: Lincoln: Trial by Fire
results.overview: Cliff Robertson narrates this dramatization focuses on the little-known life-and-death struggle of power between President Lincoln and his general in command of the Army of the Potomac, George McClellan, and the events leading to the Emancipation Proclamation.

results.title: Trial by Fire
results.overview: A prosecutor and her police officer boyfriend clash over a gruesome murder case.

results.title: Trial by Fire: Lives Re-Forged
results.overview: Imagine waking up in the hospital, bandaged from head to toe, and discovering that your life, as you knew it, had been destroyed? TRIAL BY FIRE: Lives Re-Forged chronicles the inspirational and surprising journeys of seven burn survivors before and after the harrowing accidents that forever changed their lives. When you forge metal with fire it becomes stronger - it turns out the same is true of the human spirit.

results.title: Trial By Fire: A North of 60 Mystery
results.original_title: Trial By Fire: A North of 60 Mystery
results.overview: Blood may be thicker than water, but when RCMP officer Michelle Kenidi’s brother becomes a suspect in a deadly case of arson, only one thing matters – the truth. As the evidence against her brother continues to mount, Michelle tries to defend him – but gradually realizes that he has been lying to her. Torn between her sense of duty and her loyalty to her brother, she must trust her instincts to find out what Peter has been hiding – no matter what the cost.

results.title: Trial by Fire: A Ryan Drake Story
results.original_title: Trial by Fire: A Ryan Drake Story
results.overview: Keira Frost, a former Army tech specialist newly recruited into the CIA, joins Ryan Drake’s Shepard team on a high-stakes mission. ​ As she navigates a hostile environment and skeptical teammates, Frost faces a challenge that tests both her loyalty and resilience to their limits.

results.title: Chronicles of the Five Tribes: Trial by Fire
results.original_title: Chronicles of the Five Tribes: Trial by Fire
results.overview: While being chased by a group of bandits, a hunter is born through the trials of the great expanse.

results.title: Trial by Fire: A Carrier Fights for Life
results.original_title: Trial by Fire: A Carrier Fights for Life
results.overview: Trial by Fire: A Carrier Fights for Life (1973) was produced by the United States Navy to educate Navy personnel on how to prevent fires and how to control them when they break out on a carrier at sea. The film includes actaul footage of a carrier on fire and the brave crew that worked to extinguish that fire before it became a disaster. Note: There is a background hissing noise on the audio soundtrack from the original film. This film has a runtime of approximately 19 minutes.

results.title: Trial By Fire: The New York City Fire Museum
results.original_title: Trial By Fire: The New York City Fire Museum
results.overview: Housed in a 1904 firehouse — the former home of Engine 30 — this museum chronicles the history of firefighting from colonial times to the present. The museum features horse and hand-drawn fire carriages, fire buckets and parade hats and modern day equipment. Firefighters — many of whom were involved in the World Trade Center tragedy — serve as the museum’s volunteers.

results.title: Yngwie J. Malmsteen: Trial by Fire - Live in Leningrad '89
results.original_title: Yngwie J. Malmsteen: Trial by Fire - Live in Leningrad '89
results.overview: An extended live set comprised of many of Malmsteen's hits along with his two legendary guitar performances ("Black Star" and "Far Beyond the Sun").

results.title: Maze Runner: Prueba de fuego
results.overview: Thomas y sus compañeros deben cruzar un agreste desierto para encontrar pistas que les ayuden a combatir a la malévola organización CRUEL. Durante su viaje encontrarán inimaginables obstáculos, conocerán a afectados por la enfermedad, y harán nuevos aliados.

results.title: A prueba de fuego
results.overview: En Albania, el matrimonio de Caleb y Catherine Holt está en la crisis y deciden divorciarse. Sin embargo, el padre de Caleb, John, propone que su hijo retrase su proceso de separación durante cuarenta días y siga un procedimiento llamado «El Amor Se atreven» a hacerlos amar el uno al otro otra vez.

results.title: Willingham: Prueba de fuego
results.overview: Cameron Todd Willingham fue ejecutado en Texas tras ser acusado de haber asesinado a sus tres hijos. El juez que llevó el caso rechazó las pruebas científicas y los testimonios de expertos que apuntaban hacia su inocencia, algo que el propio Willingham mantuvo desde el día en el que fue detenido.

results.title: Vivah: Amor a prueba de fuego
results.overview: El matrimonio de esta joven pareja está arreglado, y ellos disfrutan su noviazgo a la antigua. Pero, días antes de la boda, un accidente pone a prueba su amor.

results.title: Walker, Texas Ranger: Prueba de fuego
results.original_title: Walker, Texas Ranger: Trial by Fire
results.overview: Los Rangers Walker y Mills protegen a un niño de trece años, perseguido por una banda criminal, después de que el chico se hiciera con un sistema de lanzamiento de misiles. Por otra parte, Walker intentará ayudar a otro ranger que fue visto saliendo de un bar donde una mujer termina muerta.

results.title: Las Ladrilleras
results.overview: Las Ladrilleras es una cruda historia de amores y desamores, de abandonos y reconciliaciones, de amistad y traiciones. Su protagonista, Pancho, busca la felicidad en su vida y la paz para su abuela (Carmen Montejo). Uno de sus objetivos es concretar su historia de amor casándose con María, el amor de su vida. Sin embargo, el líder del barrio no está dispuesto a permitir que Pancho sea feliz tan fácilmente y, sin una razón aparente, decide hacerle la vida imposible.

results.title: The Beach
results.overview: Twenty-something Richard travels to Thailand and finds himself in possession of a strange map. Rumours state that it leads to a solitary beach paradise, a tropical bliss - excited and intrigued, he sets out to find it.

results.name: Ex on the Beach
results.overview: In this social experiment, smoking-hot celebrity singles think they're running away to paradise for a once-in-a-lifetime romantic vacation full of fun and sun. But just as the party is getting started, unwanted guests arrive to break up their good time.

known_for.title: It Couldn't Happen Here
known_for.overview: Pet Shop Boys Chris Lowe and Neil Tennant embark upon a journey across England - but which England? Is it the half-remembered England of their childhoods, or the brutal reality of Mrs Thatcher's late-eighties England? Along the way they come across many familiar (and sinister) faces. The movie also features some of the Pet Shop Boys' most popular records.

results.name: Ex on the Beach
results.overview: Smoking hot singles think they are running away to a tropical island for a once in a lifetime romantic vacation of fun and sun. But just as the party is getting starting, some unwanted guests arrive to break up their good time.

results.name: The Beach Hotel
results.overview: To celebrate his 60th birthday, Werner Gyllenmark holds a party at his beach hotel and invites his family, employees and even his arch-enemy, Egil Grip. But the event ends abruptly with an accident that shocks the entire town - and slowly but surely, explosive secrets emerge that some people will go to any lengths to keep hidden.

results.name: The Beach
results.overview: Filmmaker Warwick Thornton's international success has come at a personal cost. He has reached a crossroad in his life and something has to change. He has chosen to try giving up life in the fast lane for a while, to go it alone, on an isolated beach in one of the most beautiful yet brutal environments in the world, to see if he can transform and heal his life.

results.name: Battle on the Beach
results.overview: Three skilled teams hit the beach to renovate identical beachfront properties. With some help from Ty Pennington, Alison Victoria and Taniya Nayak, they'll compete to wow the judges with their home remodels and walk away with a $50,000 cash prize!

results.name: Ex on the Beach: Double Dutch
results.original_name: Ex on the Beach: Double Dutch
results.overview: Eight hot, sexy singles off to paradise for a summer of love ... Or so they think. They party, dating and flirting under sweltering temperatures in a tropical setting. The perfect conditions for budding romances, (a) one-night stand (s) or maybe finding true (holiday) love. When they least expect,there will be unexpected visit from their exes. Some want revenge, others hope to win back their ex. One thing is certain; hiding is pointless. Because nobody knows where and whenever a new ex will arrive.

results.name: Celebrity Ex on the Beach
results.overview: The hottest stars from the UK and the USA head off for a summer of love, with some unwelcome surprises, living at the mercy of the Tablet of Terror and heading to the beach of doom!

results.title: The Beach Bum
results.overview: An irreverent comedy about the misadventures of Moondog, a rebellious stoner and lovable rogue who lives large.

results.title: On the Beach
results.overview: In 1964, atomic war wipes out humanity in the northern hemisphere; one American submarine finds temporary safe haven in Australia, where life-as-usual covers growing despair. In denial about the loss of his wife and children in the holocaust, American Captain Towers meets careworn but gorgeous Moira Davidson, who begins to fall for him. The sub returns after reconnaissance a month (or less) before the end; will Towers and Moira find comfort with each other?

results.name: On the Beach
results.overview: The world has finally managed to blow itself up and only Australia has been spared from nuclear destruction and a gigantic wave of radiation is floating in on the breezes. One American sub located in the Pacific has survived and is met with disdain by the Australians. The calculations of Australia's most renowned scientist says the country is doomed. However, one of his rivals says that he is wrong. He believes that a 1000 people can be relocated to the northern hemisphere, where his assumptions indicate the radiation levels may be lower. The American Captain is asked to take a mission to the north to determine which scientist is right.

results.title: The Beach House
results.overview: Cara Rudland thought she’d left her Southern roots and troubled family far behind, but returns to the scenic Lowcountry of her childhood summers after losing her job in Chicago. There, she reconnects with her mother Lovie, who has been caring for her young, pregnant friend Toy in her charming beach house.

results.title: The Beach Boys
results.overview: A celebration of the legendary band that revolutionized pop music, and the iconic, harmonious sound they created that personified the California dream, captivating fans for generations and generations to come.

results.name: The San Pedro Beach Bums
results.overview: Five friends since high school decide to share a houseboat in beautiful southern California. Charming Buddy is their leader, Boychick the ladies man. Stuf believes big is beautiful, Dancer is a fidgety type and kind Moose lifts weights.

results.name: Ex On the Beach Brazil
results.original_name: De Férias com o Ex Brasil
results.overview: A reality show with 5 women and 5 men who will enjoy paradise together in a luxurious mansion. The expectation is to find new affairs and, who knows, maybe true love. However, peace is interrupted when exes of the participants begin to appear unexpectedly in each episode. They appear on the beach, a place that is feared by everyone, since the participants never know who can appear and when it will happen. Whose ex is next?

results.title: La Playa
results.overview: Impulsado por el deseo de vivir experiencias y emociones apasionantes, Richard (Leonardo DiCaprio), un joven mochilero, va a Thailandia. En Bangkok, se aloja en un hotel de mala muerte, donde conoce a una pareja de franceses, Étienne (Guillaume Canet) y Françoise (Virginie Ledoyen), y a Daffy (Robert Carlyle), un viajero consumido por años de sol y drogas y que está de vuelta de todo. Daffy, un ser tortuoso y paranoico, le cuenta a Richard una historia fantástica sobre una isla paradisíaca que nunca ha sido profanada por los turistas.

results.title: La casa de la playa
results.overview: Selin, de 21 años, vuelve al verano de 1996 y se convierte en la mejor amiga de la versión joven de su madre. La ayuda a elegir a su padre en un triángulo amoroso y descubre que los sueños que abandonó su madre han afectado a sus relaciones actuales. Selin es testigo de un amor de verano y de la magia de los 90 y anima a su madre a seguir sus aspiraciones. Nostálgica, romántica e irresistible.

results.title: Muerte en la playa
results.overview: David sale de vacaciones del colegio particular en el que estudia y visita a su madre en su lujosa redisencia cerca del mar. El joven se encuentra resentido con ella ya que nunca le procuró el cariño ni el apoyo moral que necesitaba, ésto, aunado a la violación de la que fue objeto por parte de uno de sus profesor, al cual asesinó para vengarse, lo ha llevado a convertirse en un psicópata homosexual que lleva una doble y oscura existencia de la que su padrastro comienza a sospechar. Así, David vuelve a asesinar, ahora a dos jovenes y a una chica. Su madre descubre todo y finalmente el joven que es presa de la ira y la locura muere a manos de uno de los sirvientes de su afligida madre.

results.title: La casa en la playa
results.overview: En esta escalofriante película de terror psicológico, a medida que la protagonista se enfrenta a sus peores miedos, lo que comienza como una búsqueda de respuestas se convierte en una pesadilla inexplicable. ¿Qué es real y qué es producto de una mente atormentada? En La Casa en la Playa, la línea entre la cordura y la locura es más delgada de lo que imaginas. Prepárate para un final que te dejará sin aliento.

results.name: Clases en la playa
results.overview: Un instituto privado en zona de playa... Todos los alumnos de último curso están dedicados exclusivamente a sus estudios y a la prueba de acceso a la universidad que será a finales de verano. Un día un profesor poco convencional aparece de improviso como tutor para los alumnos de último curso, su nombre es Sakurai Sakutaro,(Oda uji), y su pasado es un misterio. Nadie parace comprender lo que él trata de enseñarles, es demasiado insistente y audaz. Los estudiantes se sienten reacios a abrirse con él, que parece meter las narices en sus asuntos personales. Sin embargo Sakutaro seguirá intentando ayudarlos para que puedan ser capaces de resolver sus problemas. Los animará y guiará lo que mejor pueda, y todo ello terminará finalmente creando un gran lazo de confianza entre ellos. "Vive el momento, que sólo existe ahora"... Su mensaje irá llegando gradualmente a los estudiantes.

results.name: Christina en la playa
results.overview: Christina transforma las propiedades obsoletas de los clientes en exhibiciones de alta gama. Las cámaras la seguirán mientras busca el nuevo hogar perfecto, equilibra la maternidad, la carrera y una nueva relación.

results.title: El tiempo del Armagedón
results.overview: Paul Graff lleva una infancia tranquila en los suburbios neoyorquinos. Junto a Johnny, un compañero de clase excluido por su color de piel, se dedican a hacer travesuras. Paul cree contar con la protección de su madre, presidenta de la asociación de madres y padres de alumnos, y de su abuelo, con el que mantiene una muy buena relación. Pero, tras un incidente, es enviado a una escuela privada, cuyo consejo de administración cuenta con el padre de Donald Trump como uno de sus miembros. El elitismo y el racismo sin complejos con el que se encuentra cambiarán drásticamente su mundo.

results.title: Warlock 2: El armagedón
results.overview: Warlock, el despiadado brujo a las órdenes de Satanás, es enviado a la tierra para recuperar unas piedras cuya unión propiciará un eclipse de Sol y posteriormente el renacer del señor de las tinieblas en nuestro planeta.

results.title: Armageddon
results.overview: Un asteroide del tamaño del estado de Texas apunta directamente hacia la Tierra. Los expertos de la NASA tan sólo encuentran posible una solución: Enviar a un equipo de astronautas al espacio para que destruya el meteorito antes de que colisione con nuestro planeta. Para ello recurren a Harry Stamper, el mayor experto en perforaciones petrolíferas, y a su cualificado equipo de perforadores, para que aterricen en la superficie del asteroide, lo perforen e introduzcan un dispositivo nuclear que al estallar consiga desviar su trayectoria y poder salvar el planeta, evitando así el Armageddon.

results.title: La creación de los dioses: el reino de las tormentas

Para evitarlo, Saori Kido, decide sacrificar su vida en el Pandemonium, residencia de Lucifer, mientras que los santos de bronce lucharán para salvarla.

results.title: The King of Staten Island
results.overview: Scott has been a case of arrested development ever since his firefighter father died when he was seven. He's now reached his mid-20s having achieved little, chasing a dream of becoming a tattoo artist that seems far out of reach. As his ambitious younger sister heads off to college, Scott is still living with his exhausted ER nurse mother and spends his days smoking weed, hanging with the guys — Oscar, Igor and Richie — and secretly hooking up with his childhood friend Kelsey. But when his mother starts dating a loudmouth firefighter named Ray, it sets off a chain of events that will force Scott to grapple with his grief and take his first tentative steps toward moving forward in life.

results.title: El rey del barrio
results.overview: Un ferrocarrilero de buen corazón y desinteresado lleva una vida sorprendente en paralelo: es líder de una banda de ladrones y es experto en el arte del disfraz. Es hábil con las manos y es irresistible para las mujeres. Sin embargo, su vida se vuelve aún más complicada cuando Nena, una mujer excéntrica y adinerada, se enamora perdidamente de él y quiere casarse.

results.overview: Una comedia semiautobiográfica sobre los años que pasó Pete Davidson en Staten Island, incluyendo la muerte de su padre el 11-S y su introducción en el mundo de la comedia.

data.title: El rey del barrio
data.overview: Un ferrocarrilero de buen corazón y desinteresado lleva una vida sorprendente en paralelo: es líder de una banda de ladrones y es experto en el arte del disfraz. Sin embargo, su vida se vuelve aún más complicada cuando Nena, una mujer excéntrica y adinerada, se enamora perdidamente de él y quiere casarse.

results.title: Déja vu: Cambiando el pasado
results.overview: Tras una terrible explosión de una bomba en un Ferry de Nueva Orleans, el agente Doug Carlin descubre que es obra de un terrorista. Por su perspicacia para analizar y distinguir rápidamente lo relevante de lo secundario en el escenario del crimen, Carlin es asignado a un misterioso nuevo equipo de investigación que utiliza una sofisticada máquina que permite algo extraordinario...

results.title: Escupiré sobre tu tumba: Deja Vu
results.original_title: I Spit on Your Grave: Déjà Vu
results.overview: Después de su violación, Jennifer Hills escribió un libro con su terrible experiencia y del controvertido juicio en el que fue acusada de tomarse la ley por su mano y matar brutalmente a sus agresores. En el pequeño pueblo donde la violación y la venganza tuvieron lugar, los familiares de los cuatro violadores están furiosos de que el tribunal la declarara no culpable, y ahora son ellos los que quieren tomarse la justicia con sus propias manos...

results.name: Déjà Vu
results.overview: Una prima ballerina que lo pierde todo acepta una oferta misteriosa para viajar en el tiempo y reclamar lo que le corresponde, con un alto costo.

results.title: Steins Gate the Movie: Load Region of Déjà vu
results.original_title: 劇場版 STEINS;GATE 負荷領域のデジャヴ
results.overview: La película tiene lugar un año después de los acontecimientos de la serie de anime. Después de pasar por un camino arduo a través de múltiples líneas de tiempo debido a la invención de los "D-Mails", es decir, los mensajes de texto que se pueden enviar al pasado, Rintaro Okabe ha aterrizado, según las informaciones de la "Steins Gate", en una línea de tiempo en la que ninguno de sus amigos tendrían que morir y en la que no existe un futuro gobernado por SERN debido a que no se produjo la invención de una máquina del tiempo. Sin embargo, Okabe pronto comienza a sentir los efectos secundarios de los constantes viajes a través del tiempo por múltiples líneas de tiempo, que pronto se acumula y ocasiona que Okabe desaparezca de repente de la existencia, con sólo Kurisu Makise, la chica que él había salvado gracias a sus esfuerzos, recordándolo a través de un déjà vu. Ahora es el turno de Kurisu para encontrar una manera de conseguir que Okabe regrese a la línea de tiempo.

results.title: The Waterboy
results.overview: Bobby Boucher is a water boy for a struggling college football team. The coach discovers Boucher's hidden rage makes him a tackling machine whose bone-crushing power might vault his team into the playoffs.

results.title: Lek and the Waterboy
results.overview: 14-year-old Lek works in his mother's shop. While his best friend flirts with a new girlfriend, Lek has decidedly different fantasies.

results.title: The Waterboyz
results.overview: Selling water together on Atlanta’s mean streets, Drew and Dolo dream of escaping the trap’s grip but see very different paths to getting out.

results.title: The Way Up - Chris Long & The Waterboys
results.original_title: The Way Up - Chris Long & The Waterboys
results.overview: Narrated by award-winning actress Uma Thurman, The Way Up chronicles what it means to play for a cause for Super Bowl champion and Philadelphia Eagles defensive end Chris Long, whose legacy of service stretched from villages in Tanzania to communities across the U.S.​  The Waterboys and Chris Long Foundation work to provide clean, accessible drinking water to communities in need. As a part of that effort, the "Conquering Kili" program unites combat veterans and NFL alumni toward the common goal of conquering Africa's highest peak, Mount Kilimanjaro, while raising funding for wells that transform communities through the gift of clean water.

results.title: On Tour: The Waterboys
results.overview: The Waterboys, led by Mike Scott, is said to defy genre. With influences of Celtic, folk and rock, Scott insists on keeping the band’s songwriting fresh with creative new ideas and explosive instrumentation. In this episode, we learn about the realization of a 20-year dream, as the band performs hits like “The Whole of the Moon” and others. On Tour is a music and performance program recorded live on location at local venues in PA, NJ & DE.

results.name: Waterboyy
results.overview: Swim captain Waii is forced to step up when the university administration threatens to disband the swim club. But as he struggles with a strained family situation—and his growing feelings for a new teammate—will he be able to focus on saving the team?

results.title: Waterboys
results.overview: Both newly single, a Dutch crime author and his cellist son attempt to rekindle their feeble bond as the latter joins the former on a publicity trip to Scotland.

results.title: Waterboyz
results.overview: The newest entry in the Badazz Filmz Universe, we are proud to introduce to you The Waterboyz. Directed and written by Tone the Goat, we follow the tale of urban youths in the city just trying to turn water into money. This is through and through a coming-of-age story with a modern twist. Follow The Waterboyz through good times and times that make them grow as people and a unit. This is Badazz Film’z first production not directly written by Boosie Badazz himself, and we intend to present other filmz and media from outside sources in the future as well. So, if you believe you have what it takes to bear the Badazz moniker and you know how to contact us, get at us and let’s make it happen.

results.title: El aguador
results.overview: Un joven de 31 años, Bobby Boucher, es continuamente atormentado por los jugadores del equipo universitario para el que trabaja como aguador, debido a su carácter extraño (causado por la sobreprotección de su madre), y ante la indiferencia del entrenador. Cuando llega al equipo un nuevo míster, éste le convence para que juegue como defensa y dé rienda suelta a toda la rabia contenida que lleva dentro.

results.title: Murder on the Orient Express
results.overview: Genius Belgian detective Hercule Poirot investigates the murder of an American tycoon aboard the Orient Express train.

results.title: Murder on the Orient Express
results.overview: In 1935, when his train is stopped by deep snow, detective Hercule Poirot is called on to solve a murder that occurred in his car the night before.

results.title: Murder on the Orient Express
results.overview: Agatha Christie's classic whodunit speeds into the twenty-first century. World-famous sleuth Hercule Poirot has just finished a case in Istanbul and is returning home to London onboard the luxurious Orient Express. But, the train comes to a sudden halt when a rock slide blocks the tracks ahead. And all the thrills of riding the famous train come to a halt when a man discovered dead in his compartment, stabbed nine times. The train is stranded. No one has gotten on or gotten off. That can only mean one thing: the killer is onboard, and it is up to Hercule Poirot to find him.

results.overview: Durante un viaje en el legendario tren Orient Express, el detective belga Hercules Poirot investiga un asesinato cometido en el trayecto, y a resultas del cual todos los pasajeros del tren son sospechosos del mismo.

results.title: Muerte en el Expreso de Oriente
results.overview: Adaptación de una de las novelas más conocidas de Agatha Christie. Narra la historia de un asesinato perpetrado durante un viaje en el legendario Orient Express. La investigación del famoso detective belga Hercules Poirot (Albert Finney) tropieza con grandes dificultades, pues los ilustres pasajeros disponen de una coartada que los excluye como sospechosos. Inmejorable reparto para un film que consiguió un Óscar (mejor actriz secundaria:Ingrid Bergman) y seis nominaciones.

results.title: The Maze Runner
results.overview: A teenager with no memory of his past finds himself among a group of boys living in a walled enclosure surrounded by a massive, ever-changing maze. As he struggles to adapt to their rules and society, he begins to uncover clues that may lead to escape and the truth behind their confinement.

results.title: Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials
results.overview: Thomas and his fellow Gladers face their greatest challenge yet: searching for clues about the mysterious and powerful organization known as WCKD. Their journey takes them to the Scorch, a desolate landscape filled with unimaginable obstacles. Teaming up with resistance fighters, the Gladers take on WCKD’s vastly superior forces and uncover its shocking plans for them all.

results.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
results.overview: Thomas leads his group of escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all. Anyone who makes it out alive will get answers to the questions the Gladers have been asking since they first arrived in the maze.

results.title: Maze Runner: Correr o morir
results.overview: Thomas abre los ojos y se da cuenta que está en un ascensor. Lo extraño es que no recuerda nada, ni dónde está, ni quién es. Lo único que aún permanece intacto en su memoria es su nombre, y ya es mucho. Antes de que le dé tiempo a cuestionarse algo sobre sí mismo las puertas se abrirán y aparecerá ante él un extraño mundo. Todo lo que ve son chicos de su edad que tienen su mismo estado de amnesia. Una aventura fantástica que pronto destapará la dura realidad bajo ese velo de incertidumbre.

results.title: Maze Runner: Prueba de fuego
results.overview: Thomas y sus compañeros deben cruzar un agreste desierto para encontrar pistas que les ayuden a combatir a la malévola organización CRUEL. Durante su viaje encontrarán inimaginables obstáculos, conocerán a afectados por la enfermedad, y harán nuevos aliados.

results.title: Maze Runner: La cura mortal
results.overview: El joven héroe Thomas no puede confiar en la organización CRUEL, entonces con sus amigos se embarca en una misión para encontrar una cura para la enfermedad mortal conocida como La Llamarada.

results.title: Die Hard: With a Vengeance
results.overview: New York detective John McClane is back and kicking bad-guy butt in the third installment of this action-packed series, which finds him teaming with civilian Zeus Carver to prevent the loss of innocent lives. McClane thought he'd seen it all, until a genius named Simon engages McClane, his new "partner" -- and his beloved city -- in a deadly game that demands their concentration.

results.name: Battle Angel
results.overview:
Doc Ido, a doctor and mechanic who lives and works in the postapocalyptic "Scrapyard", finds the remains of a female cyborg in a junk heap.

After he revives and rebuilds her, the amnesiac "Gally" begins a life for herself in a world where every day can bring a new fight.

results.title: Battle Angel
results.overview: In his travels as a bounty hunter, Hunter–Warrior and cyborg healer Ido one day discovers and repairs the remnants of a cyborg whom he names Gally. Though possessing the body of a young woman, Gally now embodies Ido's most sophisticated and lethal cybernetic skills. The preternaturally strong, amnesiac Gally begins to forge a life for herself in a world where every day is a struggle for survival.

results.title: Gunnm 3D Special
results.overview: A 3 minute 3D-CGI rendered movie clip included with volume 6 of the Gunnm: Complete Edition manga reprint. It showcases Alita in a Third League motorball race with players from two of her races such as "Armor" Togo, Degchalev, and Valdicci, and depicts events from both of those races.

results.title: Battle Angel: La última guerrera
results.overview: Cuenta la historia de Alita, una joven chica en el cuerpo de un cyborg que es rescatada por un científico tras ser encontrada entre los escombros de un desguace. Alita es reconstruida poco a poco, pero se da cuenta que ha perdido la memoria y no recuerda nada de lo que ha sido de ella antes de aterrizar en el desguace. La joven verá en el científico a su salvador, una figura paterna que la convertirá en un ser letal y peligroso para conseguir así un trabajo como cazarrecompensas.

results.title: Buenos días, Vietnam
results.overview: Durante la Guerra de Vietnam, Adrian Cronauer, un disc-jockey de la Fuerza Aérea de los Estados Unidos, llega a Saigón para entretener a los soldados desplegados en Vietnam. Al principio todo es diversión, pero poco a poco los jefes se darán cuenta de que sus comentarios acerca de la guerra no son "políticamente correctos". Por lo mismo, deciden expulsarlo y enviarlo de nuevo a su hogar, mientras que en la radio colocan sucesores que no dan la talla y no gustan tanto como él. Los soldados le piden que vuelva, sin saber que le expulsarían por sus comentarios.

results.overview: Poco después de que la legendaria estrella del kung fu Jackie Chan sea invitada a adoptar a un querido panda del zoo llamado Hu Hu, un famoso sindicato del crimen internacional pone sus ojos en el famoso oso y ofrece una enorme recompensa por su captura. Ante esta repentina crisis, Jackie Chan recurre a la ayuda de su agente y del feroz cuidador de Hu Hu, y el trío se embarca en una aventura en la que intentarán ser más listos que los malos en todo momento.

results.title: Bride Wars
results.overview: Two best friends become rivals when their respective weddings are accidentally booked for the same day.

results.title: Bride Wars
results.overview: Mary and Jing are childhood best friends. When they were kids, they dreamed about their ideal weddings. Ten years later, on the day of their weddings, however, a mistake by the wedding planner pits them against each other, in a battle of wits.

results.title: Guerra de novias
results.overview: Emma y Liv han sido desde siempre muy buenas amigas (de aquellas que se apoyan en todo, a las buenas y a las malas) y, desde su infancia, han soñado con casarse en junio en el Hotel Plaza de Nueva York. Una ilusión que van a poder compartir y planificar juntas, ya que sus peticiones de mano ocurren con poco tiempo de diferencia y sus bodas van a ser el mismo fin de semana. Un error administrativo, sin embargo, agrieta esta felicidad: las bodas han sido reservadas para el mismo día, y una de las dos va a tener que cambiar la fecha. Sin estar dispuestas a renunciar a su sueño, y utilizando todas las armas que tienen a su alcance, empezará entonces una feroz competición entre Liv y Emma para conseguir la reserva del Hotel Plaza.

results.name: Maggie: La Vidente
results.overview: Dotada de habilidades psíquicas, Maggie debe aceptar sus visiones del futuro a diario. Hipersensible, la joven capta la energía de las personas que la rodean. Para protegerse de posibles ataques emocionales, tiene que poner barreras, que desde fuera dan la impresión de que es cínica y defensiva. Debajo de su caparazón, Maggie es en realidad una gran romántica con un gran corazón, que solo quiere encontrar una manera de vivir lo que ella considera una vida normal, con relaciones normales y, en última instancia, encontrar el amor. Con la ayuda de su círculo íntimo de amigos y familiares, Maggie intenta vivir como el resto de nosotros, creando el mejor futuro para ella, con solo la información del presente.

results.title: Maggie
results.overview: Un peligroso virus se está extendiendo por todas partes infectando a los habitantes de todo el mundo. Maggie es una joven adolescente de 16 años que vive junto a su familia en una pequeña granja de los EEUU. El virus avanza y Maggie termina infectada. Wade, el padre de la niña, no está dispuesto a renunciar a su pequeña y dejar que la aparten y aíslen en su agonizante y peligrosa transformación en un muerto viviente.

results.name: Maggie y la Bestia Feroz
results.overview: Las aventuras mágicas en la Tierra de Ninguna Parte de una niña y sus juguetes de peluche favoritos, incluyendo una criatura de lunares rojos llamada la Bestia Feroz, que es poca feroz; y Hamilton Hocks, un cerdito tímido cantante. Basada en los libros infantiles de Betty y Michael Paraskevas.

results.title: El Plan de Maggie
results.overview: Maggie nunca ha tenido una relación que dure más de seis meses – pero desesperadamente quiere tener un bebe, así que le solicita una donación de esperma a un amigo. Justo acaba de empezar el proceso de inseminación artificial cuando consuma un romance con John, un triste académico casado considerado el chico malo de la antropología fictocrítica. El entusiasmo rejuvenecedor aleja a John de su dominante esposa danesa, Georgette Nørgaard, y decide establecerse con Maggie para criar a su hija. Todo sale según el plan de Maggie, pero por alguna razón no está feliz. El plan de Maggie es una encantadora, sofisticada y chistosa exploración de las complejidades inesperadas de un romance moderno.

known_for.title: Búsqueda implacable
known_for.overview: Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) es un agente especial jubilado. Pero cuando su hija Kim (Maggie Grace) es secuestrada en París por una organización criminal albanokosovar, tendrá que volver a la acción para intentar salvarla. La banda se dedica a una red de trata de blancas, por lo que Mills sabe que sólo dispone de unas horas para conseguir rescatarla antes de que se pierda el rastro de su hija.

known_for.title: Búsqueda implacable 2
known_for.overview: Aunque ya está retirado, Bryan Mills se ve obligado a utilizar todos sus recursos y habilidades de agente de la CIA para salvar tanto la vida de su mujer y de su hija como la suya propia. El padre de uno de los secuestradores albaneses que lo tuvieron en jaque en el primer film jura vengarse y aprovecha las vacaciones de la familia Mills en Estambul para llevar a cabo su plan. Una vez más parece que subestiman al ex agente de la CIA.

known_for.title: Búsqueda implacable 3
known_for.overview: La vida del ex-agente especial Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) se ve inesperadamente truncada tras el brutal asesinato de su ex mujer. Tras ser acusado de su muerte, se ve obligado a huir de la implacable persecución de la CIA, el FBI y la policía. Una vez más, deberá usar sus “habilidades especiales” para hacer justicia, dar caza a los verdaderos asesinos y proteger lo único que le queda en la vida: su hija.

results.overview: A retired contract killer goes on a bloody rampage when a young girl finds herself at the mercy of gangland human traffickers and only one man can come to her rescue, with an arsenal of weapons and years of experience in the art of killing.

results.title: Líbranos del mal
results.overview: Cuando una espantosa ola de violencia recorre la ciudad de Nueva York, Sarchie, un policía problemático, no logra encontrar una explicación racional de los crímenes bizarros. Sin embargo, sus ojos se abren a una realidad alterna aterradora cuando el renegado sacerdote jesuita, Mendoza le convence que la posesión demoníaca puede ser la culpa de los horrendos asesinatos. Juntos, realizan una valiente lucha sobrenatural para librar a la ciudad de un mal de otro mundo.

results.title: Líbranos del mal
results.overview: Un asesino va a Tailandia para resolver un caso de secuestro vinculado a él, y se ve perseguido por un hombre a cuyo hermano mató.

results.title: Líbranos del mal
results.overview: En una Iglesia, Gabriel se confiesa arrepentido de los pensamientos sexuales que tiene con niños. Un sacerdote lo escucha atentamente. Gabriel se marcha libremente de la Iglesia, dejando abierta la pregunta de quién confesó a quién

results.title: In Time
results.overview: In the not-too-distant future, the aging gene has been switched off. To avoid overpopulation, time has become the currency and the way people pay for luxuries and necessities. The rich can live forever, while the rest struggle to negotiate for their immortality. A poor young man who suddenly comes into a fortune of time finds himself on the run from a corrupt police force known as the "time keepers".

results.title: Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood
results.overview: Los Angeles, 1969. TV star Rick Dalton, a struggling actor specializing in westerns, and stuntman Cliff Booth, his best friend, try to survive in a constantly changing movie industry. Dalton is the neighbor of the young and promising actress and model Sharon Tate, who has just married the prestigious Polish director Roman Polanski…

results.title: Once Upon a Time in America
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in America
results.overview: A former Prohibition-era Jewish gangster returns to the Lower East Side of Manhattan over thirty years later, where he once again must confront the ghosts and regrets of his old life.

results.name: Adventures in Time
results.overview: Violeta lives with her uncle because her mother died soon after she was born and she never knew her father, she stays with her grandmother from time to time as well. Violeta has a boyfriend named Ángel who gives her a pet dog. While at her grandmother's house, Violeta discovers a time machine that her grandfather built, so she and her friends travel to different time periods. They visit several important events in Mexican history, learning these stories firsthand.

results.title: We Live in Time
results.overview: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.

results.name: Once Upon a Time in Russia
results.overview: Russia is the richest country with a lot of oil, gas and problems. A humorous satirical show consisting of all-Russian social and everyday realities, “Once Upon a Time in Russia” does not solve any of them. It laughs at them.

results.title: Somewhere in Time
results.overview: Young writer Richard Collier is met on the opening night of his first play by an old lady who begs him to "Come back to me". Mystified, he tries to find out about her, and learns that she is a famous stage actress from the early twentieth century. Becoming more and more obsessed with her, by self-hypnosis he manages to travel back in time—where he meets her.

results.name: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
results.original_name: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
results.overview: In Victorian England, the young and beautiful Alice tells a tale of a strange new land that exists on the other side of a rabbit hole. Thinking Alice insane, her doctors aim to make her forget everything. While Alice is ready to put it all behind her, she knows this world is real. In the nick of time, the Knave of Hearts and the White Rabbit save her from a doomed fate. Together, the trio tumble down the rabbit hole to Wonderland, where nothing is impossible.

results.title: Cinderella III: A Twist in Time
results.original_title: Cinderella III: A Twist in Time
results.overview: When Lady Tremaine steals the Fairy Godmother's wand and changes history, it's up to Cinderella to restore the timeline and reclaim her prince.

results.title: A Wrinkle in Time
results.overview: After the disappearance of her scientist father, three peculiar beings send Meg, her brother, and her friend to space in order to find him.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in Mexico
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Mexico
results.overview: A corrupt CIA agent Sands hires hitman El Mariachi to assassinate a Mexican general hired by a drug kingpin attempting a coup d'état of the President of Mexico.

results.name: Big Time in Hollywood, Fl
results.overview: Follows two delusional brothers, who are self-proclaimed filmmakers, as they are kicked out of their parent's house and end up on an epic cinematic journey.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
results.overview: As the railroad builders advance unstoppably through the Arizona desert on their way to the sea, Jill arrives in the small town of Flagstone with the intention of starting a new life.

results.name: Just in Time
results.overview: When middle-aged Xu Mengan is hit by career setbacks, family troubles, and an unexpected second pregnancy, her once-stable life unravels. As she fights to regain balance and rediscover her own strength, her best friend Chen Wanzhen and sister Xu Mengxin face their own crises—from returning to the workforce after years as a housewife to navigating the emotional strain of pregnancy. Together, these women confront life’s pressures and find a path toward renewal, resilience, and second growth.

results.name: Love In Time
results.overview: He Zhengyu, a cold and arrogant lawyer living in 2022, moves into an older apartment complex and discovers a strange time-space phenomenon that connects his apartment with the previous tenant from four months earlier in 2021. Every night from 10:06 to 10:52, He Zhengyu and Chen Jialan, the former tenant, become involuntary roommates. When He Zhengyu learns that Chen Jialan knows Jiang Shenghao, a person connected to one of his clients, he seeks her help. Together, they use the time-space anomaly to their advantage, hoping to alter events in 2021 and change the future.

results.name: The Vampire Dies in No Time
results.overview:
In Shin-Yokohama, humans engage in a long, drawn out battle against vampires. Amongst them, the last "true vampire" stands...

Will he be a bringer of peace, or destruction?

results.name: Where in Time Is Carmen Sandiego?
results.original_name: Where in Time Is Carmen Sandiego?
results.overview: A game show based on the Carmen Sandiego computer game series created by Brøderbund Software.

results.name: In the Nick of Time
results.overview: Five people, strangers to each other, are in the wrong place at the wrong time. They witness a murder and from then on an endless tangle of adventures begins for them. Dalia, Zoumboulia, Spyros, Fotis, Angela... unite in a group, draw strength from each other and aim to deliver justice in an old and dark case... Through dangers and upheavals they will manage to reach in the truth of the case but also their own, personal truth.

results.name: The Time in Between
results.overview: Sira Quiroga is a young Spanish dressmaker engaged to a solid suitor when a suave typewriter salesman upends her life. Spain is being upended by a civil war and the new regime's growing alliances with Nazi Germany. Sira, smart, gutsy and resourceful with a Scarlett O'Hara-like ability to whip up designer duds on a moment's notice, Sira has spunk. Sira gains and loses a small fortune, is dumped by her cad of a lover in Morocco, runs guns to get the cash to start her life anew and becomes couturier to the Nazi wives stationed in Madrid. Urged on by her friend, the real-life British spy Rosalinda Fox, Sira, too, aids the British cause.

results.name: Just in Time
results.overview: Harry Stadlin becomes the new editor of the magazine West Coast, a California publication. He finds himself with a talented staff who are a little eccentric with complicated lives.

results.title: El Precio del Mañana
results.overview: Ambientada en una sociedad futura. El hallazgo de una fórmula contra el envejecimiento trae consigo no sólo superpoblación, sino también la transformación del tiempo en moneda de cambio que permite sufragar tanto lujos como necesidades. Los ricos pueden vivir para siempre, pero los demás tendrán que negociar cada minuto de vida, y los pobres mueren jóvenes. Después de conseguir, por casualidad, una inmensa cantidad de tiempo Will Salas, un joven obrero, será perseguido por unos policías corruptos conocidos como “los guardianes del tiempo”. En su huida Will tomará una rehén, una joven de una familia adinerada.

results.name: The Big Game
results.overview: Sixteen contestants of a new survival show are taken to the Siberian taiga to compete for the price of one million euros. The rules are simple: no food, personal belongings, electricity, communications and civilization for hundreds of kilometers around. The one remains wins. Soon TV project turns into a deadly game, where LIFE becomes the main prize... What is it? Is it sick TV script? Who is behind this? And who can survive without losing their humanity?

results.title: Big Game
results.overview: Air Force One is shot down by terrorists, leaving the President of the United States stranded in the wilderness of Finland. 13-year-old Oskari is on a hunting mission to prove his maturity to his kinsfolk by tracking down a deer, but instead discovers the President in an escape pod. With the terrorists closing in to capture their prize, the unlikely duo team up to escape their hunters.

known_for.name: AEW Dark
known_for.overview: AEW Dark is a weekly web series featuring untelevised matches from the TNT series AEW Dynamite. Former WCW announcer Tony Schiavone hosts the program.

results.name: Big Game
results.overview: There is a year left until the World Cup. After another loss to the national team, the fans decide to choose a new coach from among their own. And now the humble chef Dima faces the most difficult task: not only to assemble a team of the best players and work out winning schemes, but also to reach the World Cup playoffs for the first time in the history of Russian football. And if legendary football players can help him in this, then everyone is ready to put sticks in the wheels, starting from sports officials and ending with his subordinates who do not take self-taught seriously.

results.title: Big Game
results.overview: Sully is a psychotic criminal who has just been released from prison. Now he has only one goal: revenge against police detective Elaine Reynolds, who he blames for the death of his wife's unborn child.

results.name: The PokerStars.net Big Game
results.overview: The ultimate high-stakes TV cash game show that sees Loose Cannon amateurs play against the legends of poker for cold hard cash. PokerStars buys each Loose Cannon into the game for $100,000, and they get to keep any profit. It’s a true test of poker skill, and the best thing to happen to TV poker in years.

results.title: Big Game

results.title: Big Game

Boone Speed, Chris Sharma, and Nate Gold finally realize the dream of going to the fabled Castle Hill basin to see if Boone's spray is ligit. The colossal Flock Hill area has recently re-opened to climbing, adding to the already Phenomenal limestone bouldering of the valley. Guest starring Lauren Lee, Chris Tartaglia, Melissa Lacasse, Cynthia Levinthal, and more.

results.title: 'Big Game'
results.overview: This guy named Tony goes on an epic walk through the park and meets some nice guys that are really kind. That's essentially the movie, the guy just meets some really nice people.

results.title: Big Game Haunt
results.overview: Colonel Rimfire chases Cool Cat into a deserted house. Unfortunately, they are not alone. A ghost tries to befriend the two, but neither of them want to be friends with him because he is a spook.
